text:
Maria (Design): flipping the compact vectors preview again — added a slim 'results toolbar' above the relevance table for quick actions (rerank, sample, export). Mock attached. Thoughts? :eyes:
Jasper (Eng): nice, visually light. main concern: fixed toolbar height + table pagination could cause vertical overflow on small laptop windows. can we make it sticky only on wide screens?
Aisha (Product): sticky on wide, collapsible on small sounds good. also want an explicit ‘Export selection’ affordance — users keep asking where CSV export went.
Devon (ML): rerank action needs to clearly show which model/version ran and latency estimate. otherwise analysts will be confused when scores change after rerank.
Kevin (A11y): a11y nits: toolbar buttons need visible focus states, proper aria-labels (not just icons), and keyboard shortcuts should be discoverable. can we include a condensed label toggle for screen readers? :a11y:
Maria (Design): agree on ARIA. Mock now shows icons + short labels, but we could expose a screen-reader-only line with full descriptions. also exploring a pin icon so the toolbar can be collapsed into the header.
Jasper (Eng): implementation notes: toolbar should be rendered outside table scroll container so it doesn't reflow with rows. for collapsed mode we can reuse existing kebab menu component. downside: extra click for power users.
Aisha (Product): maybe default to expanded for accounts with > 5 exports/month and collapsed for new users. can be in settings.
Devon (ML): on rerank UX — when user triggers 'Rerank by model', we should snapshot the original scores and show a small diff pill next to each score (▲/▼ + value). also surface which rerank prompt was used.
Maria (Design): good call. small diff pill fits in the score column if we reduce precision to 2 decimals. shows change without crowding.
Kevin (A11y): keyboard navigation flow: focus enters toolbar, left/right to move buttons, Enter to activate. If we add a menu, ensure Escape returns focus to the origin cell. Also color contrast checks for the diff pills (needs 4.5:1 for text).
Jasper (Eng): noted. we'll add focus-trap-freeable region and ARIA roles. for export, confirm formats: CSV, JSONL, and copy-to-clipboard.
Aisha (Product): yes CSV + JSONL + 'Copy rows' is ideal. also add an option to export only selected columns.
Maria (Design): putting quick column toggles in the toolbar felt busy — alternative: a small 'Columns' modal that opens from the toolbar. keeps toolbar tidy.
Devon (ML): for batch rerank we should show estimated cost and time before queuing. small confirmation modal with sample preview.
Maria (Design): draft copy for confirmation modal: "Rerank X selected vectors using MODEL_NAME? Estimated time: ~Y seconds. Results will replace current scores. Proceed?" feedback on tone?
Aisha (Product): terse and action-oriented. maybe change "replace current scores" -> "update displayed relevance scores" (less scary).
Kevin (A11y): include cancel focus target on modal and ensure motion reduced for users with prefers-reduced-motion.
ui-bot: deploy-preview updated with latest toolbar mock: https://redwood.mock/compact-toolbar/v2 — comments enabled.
Jasper (Eng): will prototype DOM structure and share a PR with CSS vars for compact spacing. can someone confirm the minimal viewport where toolbar collapses?
Maria (Design): collapse breakpoint at 720px in the mock. that keeps 3-column relevance table usable.
Aisha (Product): ok — ship criteria: keyboard accessible toolbar, export options + copy, rerank snapshot diffs, confirmation modal with cost estimate, a11y checks passed.
Devon (ML): also include telemetry event names: rerank_initiated, rerank_completed, export_initiated, export_format. helps us correlate regressions.
Maria (Design): perfect. I'll update the mock with the diff pill, modal copy change, and accessibility notes, then attach the Figma file.
Kevin (A11y): I'll run a quick contrast audit on the diff color tokens and post results.
Aisha (Product): timeline: design follow-up today, eng spikes next week, ship in next sprint if no surprises. :thumbsup:
Maria (Design): thanks all — leaving a few inline comments in the Figma.
Jasper (Eng): thx, will pick this up in the spike.
Aisha (Product): moving to next steps.
Maria (Design): end.
